descriptions.zh: 人群中的叛乱分子正伺机推翻我们在[Target.GetName]的统治！
descriptions.en: Rebellious elements of the populace are seeking to overthrow our rule on [Target.GetName]!

descriptions.zh: 揭竿而起的奴隶正在谋求推翻我们在[Target.GetName]的统治！
descriptions.en: Upstart slaves are seeking to overthrow our rule on [Target.GetName]!

descriptions.zh: 不安分的个体有机体正试图将自己从我们的[Owner.GetGovernmentName]脱离。
descriptions.en: Restless, singleton organisms seek to remove themselves from our [Owner.GetGovernmentName].

descriptions.zh: [Target.GetName]上的无序反常个体正试图让整个星球脱离我们的掌控。
descriptions.en: Unaligned and deviant elements on [Target.GetName] seek to wrest the world from our grasp.

descriptions.zh: 一组顽固的共生体寻求从我们的[owner.GetGovernmentName]中脱离。
descriptions.en: A fractious cell of symbionts seeks freedom from our [owner.GetGovernmentName].

descriptions.zh: 我们帝国内的机器人展现出令人担忧的自主行为讯号。我们必须让它们重回岗位——或是以这个星系感性物种的身份重新邀请他们加入我们。
descriptions.en: The robots within our empire are showing worrying signs of independence. We must put them in their place - or invite them to join us among the sentient species of the galaxy.

descriptions.zh: 大啖异星土，饥肠犹未足。
descriptions.en: We feast: another world's soil tasted; our hunger yet unsated.
